en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you have eaten something, so lie down upon you back and place your right leg upon the left’.
en.sarwar: 21. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When you eat [something], then lie down on your back, then place your right leg on your left leg.’”
